schema.description: A vetter draws its tick of attestation tokens. The draw is unconditional and on a schedule — a vetter asks whether or not it has vetted anyone — because a fetch that tracked activity would report activity.

label.description: The token label to draw under: the community's current monthly label, or an event label it has approved for this vetter.

requests.description: One blinded serial per token asked for. More than the community's published `dripPerTick` is refused outright — the cap is the community's, not the asker's restraint.

commitment.description: A commitment to a serial only the vetter knows.

openingProof.description: Proof that the commitment opens to a serial the vetter holds, bound to this label, member and tick.

tick.description: Which tick of this label is being drawn: tick `t` is the window starting `t` tick lengths after the label's start instant (see the specification's Definitions). The community refuses a tick that has not begun (`tickNotYet`) and one already served (`alreadyServed`), so the total drawn under a label is bounded by the drip rate times the ticks elapsed.
